title: Awakening Joy
speaker: James Baraz and Shoshana Alexander
summary: James Baraz and Shoshana Alexander speak about well-being and ease under the title Awakening Joy, though the transcript is only a handful of fragments. The passages include an admission that sometimes a person prefers being grumpy to being happy, a mention of a place in us that longs to develop something, and a study saying the average American is exposed to about three thousand messages a day unless on retreat. The text ends on the line "Just imagine if." Too much is missing to tell how these pieces connect.
topics: gold (as in the concept of renunciation)
